notes.title: TGS2024 and announcement of joint development with ACQUIRE Corp.
notes.notes:
Developed in collaboration with ACQUIRE Corp., Black Finger JET aims to create highly unique visuals that fuse 2D characters (pixel art) with 3D backgrounds!

More new footage will be on display at TGS2024, which will be held from September 26th to 29th✨

The development staff look forward to seeing you at the Red Dunes Games booth [08-N02]!

[previewyoutube=ABTbVYfKVwc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The alpha version teaser exhibited at TGS2023 has been posted on Steam.
notes.notes:
The alpha version teaser exhibited at TGS2023 has been posted on Steam.

This is our first progress report, three months after our development was announced.
We are still in the early stages of development, so we haven't been able to do everything we wanted to do, but we would like to let you know that our development is definitely moving forward.

Please let us know your thoughts.

[previewyoutube=UOIzt3edIgQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: [Event Exhibition] Participation in TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023 has been confirmed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44109939/b4f9080182203aae50fe8fb7efe38986f028106f.jpg[/img]

"Black Finger JET" is confirmed to be exhibited at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023!

We are planning to showcase a demo where you can see the gameplay screens, and also distribute clear files featuring key visuals illustrated by the main designer, akio.

But that's not all! The original Metal Slug programmer, HAMACHAN, has joined the project team.
Producer: MEEHER
Sound Production: HIYA!
Pixel Artist: Kuichin
Director: Shinano Ishiguro
And more BFJ staff members will be waiting at the venue!

We would be delighted if as many people as possible could come and see it.
(*Our staff members will be very happy if you come and talk to them at the venue.)

Everyone, let's meet at the venue for sure!

■Exhibiting Company Name
KOHACHI STUDIO

■Event Period
9/21 (Thu) - 9/24 (Sun)

■Venue
Makuhari Messe in JAPAN
